8888-the-wept-of-wish-ton-wish.creator: J. Fenimore Cooper
8888-the-wept-of-wish-ton-wish.description: A book by J. Fenimore Cooper. land we enjoy for its present state of security and abundance. It is the humble object of the tale that will be found in the succeeding pages, to perpetuate the recollection of some of the practices and events peculiar to the early days of our history.

arxiv-1403-6348.title: Updating Formulas and Algorithms for Computing Entropy and Gini Index from Time-Changing Data Streams
arxiv-1403-6348.creator: Blaž Sovdat
arxiv-1403-6348.description: Abstract Despite growing interest in data stream mining the most successful incremental learners still use periodic recomputation to update attribute information gains and Gini indices. This note provides simple incremental formulas and algorithms for computing entropy and Gini index from time-changing data streams.

arxiv-2107-05101.title: Machine Learning Challenges and Opportunities in the African Agricultural Sector. A General Perspective.
arxiv-2107-05101.creator: Racine Ly
arxiv-2107-05101.description: Abstract 1 Introduction The improvement of computers’ capacities, advancements in algorithmic techniques, and the significant increase of available data have enabled the recent developments of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology. One of its branches, called Machine Learning (ML), has shown strong capacities in mimicking characteristics attributed to human intelligence, such as vision, speech, and problem-solving.

arxiv-2111-01221.title: Robust Federated Learning via Over-The-Air Computation
arxiv-2111-01221.creator: Houssem Sifaou and Geoffrey Ye Li
arxiv-2111-01221.description: Abstract This paper investigates the robustness of over-the-air federated learning to Byzantine attacks. The simple averaging of the model updates via over-the-air computation makes the learning task vulnerable to random or intended modifications of the local model updates of some malicious clients.

arxiv-2204-07774.title: Light transport through amorphous photonic materials with localization and bandgap regimes
arxiv-2204-07774.creator: Frank Scheffold, Jakub Haberko, Sofia Magkiriadou, Luis S. Froufe-Pérez
arxiv-2204-07774.description: Abstract We propose a framework that unifies the description of light transmission through three-dimensional amorphous dielectric materials that exhibit both localization and a photonic bandgap. We argue that direct, coherent reflection near and in the bandgap attenuates the generation of diffuse or localized photons.

arxiv-2205-00859.title: Bayesian Monitoring of COVID-19 in Sweden
arxiv-2205-00859.creator: Robin Marin, Håkan Runvik, Alexander Medvedev, Stefan Engblom
arxiv-2205-00859.description: Abstract In an effort to provide regional decision support for the public healthcare, we design a data-driven compartment-based model of COVID-19 in Sweden. From national hospital statistics we derive parameter priors, and we develop linear filtering techniques to drive the simulations given data in the form of daily healthcare demands.

arxiv-2303-12824.title: Kempe equivalence and quadratic toric rings
arxiv-2303-12824.creator: Hidefumi Ohsugi and Akiyoshi Tsuchiya
arxiv-2303-12824.description: Abstract . Perfectly contractile graphs form a typical class of perfect graphs. In particular, all k k -colorings of a perfectly contractile graph are Kempe equivalent. Everett and Reed conjectured that a graph is perfectly contractile if and only if it contains no odd holes, no antiholes and no odd prisms.

arxiv-2410-02497.title: Optical galaxy cluster mock catalogs with realistic projection effects: Validations with the SDSS clusters
arxiv-2410-02497.creator: Andy Lee, Hao-Yi Wu, Andrés N. Salcedo, Tomomi Sunayama, Matteo Costanzi, Justin Myles, Shulei Cao, Eduardo Rozo, Chun-Hao To, David H. Weinberg, Lei Yang, Conghao Zhou
arxiv-2410-02497.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Andy Lee, Hao-Yi Wu, Andrés N. Salcedo, Tomomi Sunayama, Matteo Costanzi, Justin Myles, Shulei Cao, Eduardo Rozo, Chun-Hao To, David H. Weinberg, Lei Yang, Conghao Zhou. Galaxy clusters identified in optical imaging surveys suffer from projection effects: Physically unassociated galaxies along a cluster’s line of sight can be counted as its members and boost the observed richness (the number of cluster members).

arxiv-2507-16628.title: Augmenting Von Neumann’s Architecture for an Intelligent Future
arxiv-2507-16628.creator: Rajpreet Singh, Vidhi Kothari
arxiv-2507-16628.description: Abstract This work presents a novel computer architecture that extends the Von Neumann model with a dedicated Reasoning Unit (RU) to enable native artificial general intelligence capabilities. The RU functions as a specialized co-processor that executes symbolic inference, multi-agent coordination, and hybrid symbolic-neural computation as fundamental architectural primitives.

pmc-10512661.title: DAP1 regulates osteoblast autophagy via the ATG16L1–LC3 axis in Graves’ disease-induced osteoporosis
pmc-10512661.creator: Mingdong Gao, Zouxi Du, Qianqian Dong, Shan Su, Limin Tian
pmc-10512661.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectiveThis study aimed to uncover a critical protein and its mechanisms in modulating autophagy in Graves’ disease (GD)-induced osteoporosis (OP).MethodsWe discovered the target protein, death-associated protein 1 (DAP1), using bone proteomics analysis. Furthermore, genetic overexpression and knockdown (KD) of DAP1 in bone and MC3T3-E1 cells revealed DAP1 effects on autophagy and osteogenic markers, and autophagic vacuoles in cells were detected using transmission electron microscopy and the microtubule-associated protein 1 light chain 3 alpha (MAP1LC3/LC3) dual fluorescence system.

pmc-10634039.title: Developing a digital informed consent app: opportunities and challenges of a new format to inform and obtain consent in public health research
pmc-10634039.creator: Luuk V Haring, Joy T Hall, Anton Janssen, J Marleen Johannes, Arnoud P Verhoeff, Joanne K Ujcic-Voortman
pmc-10634039.description: BackgroundInformed consent procedures for large population-based cohort studies should be comprehensive and easy-to-use. This is particularly challenging when participants from different socio-economic groups and multicultural ethnic backgrounds are involved. Recently, more and more studies have tried to use multimedia in informed consent procedures.

pmc-11509291.title: On the Roles of Protein Intrinsic Disorder in the Origin of Life and Evolution
pmc-11509291.creator: Vladimir N Uversky, Jacques Fantini, André Brack
pmc-11509291.description: Obviously, the discussion of different factors that could have contributed to the origin of life and evolution is clear speculation, since there is no way of checking the validity of most of the related hypotheses in practice, as the corresponding events not only already happened, but took place in a very distant past.

pmc-11692188.title: CURRENT TRENDS IN THE DIRECT CARE WORKFORCE
pmc-11692188.creator: Christopher Kelly, Jerome Deichert
pmc-11692188.description: We used data from the 2020-2022 American Community Survey to examine trends among direct care workers (DCWs) in both occupation and industry. We found the number of nursing assistants, psychiatric aides, and home health aides decreased 5.8%, to nearly 1.9 million, while the number of personal and home care aides decreased 0.8%, to more than 1.3 million.

pmc-12569012.title: Mapping prescriptive beliefs on seventh generation stewardship and increasing the temporal scope of intergenerational concern
pmc-12569012.creator: Kyle Fiore Law, Stylianos Syropoulos, Liane Young, Brendan Bo O’Connor
pmc-12569012.description: As concerns over climate change, pandemics, and other intergenerational issues mount, the call for intergenerational stewardship resounds in psychology, ethics, and politics. Yet, the virtue of intergenerational beneficence has deep roots in historical philosophical perspectives, such as the principle of seventh generation stewardship advocated by the Haudenosaunee Confederacy and other indigenous populations.

pmc-12740855.title: Long-term survival after ALK-TKI resistance through immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy in ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer: a case report
pmc-12740855.creator: Caihong Fu, Lei Yang, Hui Qiao, Xiting Liu, Jiexin Wang
pmc-12740855.description: Anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) gene fusions represent one of the most common driver mutations in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Currently, targeted drug options for ALK fusion-positive patients exhibit diversity, with third-generation drugs achieving a 5-year progression-free survival (PFS) rate exceeding 60%.

pmc-12748899.title: Deep Learning-Driven Early Diagnosis of Respiratory Diseases using CNN-RNN Fusion on Lung Sound Data
pmc-12748899.creator: Thulasi Bikku, Satya Sree K.P.N.V., Srinivasarao Thota, Jeevana Jyothi Pujari, Raj Kumar Batchu, Pouria Mortezaagha, Malligunta Kiran Kumar, Raju Anitha
pmc-12748899.description: This research depicts a deep learning-based algorithm designed for lung sound analysis, which combines Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) architectures to improve early disease detection. With comprehensive datasets from Coswara and ICBHI, the algorithm is proficient in distinguishing a spectrum of respiratory diseases, including pneumonia, asthma, and Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD).

pmc-13356080.creator: Houmam Anees, Reem Jamous, Christian Heiss, Thaqif El Khassawna, Christoph Biehl
pmc-13356080.description: Inflammatory rheumatic diseases are major contributors to morbidity and healthcare utilisation worldwide. However, nationwide data on long-term hospitalisation trends remain limited.
